text_block_list.text:
Having lost the Oka Sho victory and been 
defeated by Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to claim the "No. 1" spot at the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks), she threw herself 
into training with burning passion.
